finding: The event Prepare of PENDING checks only the dependencies inside the run and the wave record, so it accepts an entry with returned: true. The proposal says that a returned story stays pending until the end of the run, and BR-117 lets only dispatch add take a returned finding back. By hand, dispatch prepare-story ST-0351 for a returned ST-0351 in the closed wave 1 passes both checks and starts the story again that the User returned. Add a refusal for an entry with returned: true to Prepare, to BR-113 and to the prepare-story bullet of interface-contracts.md, and add a Scenario to RL-07. Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: By hand the implementation agent starts a story only after the User's go, and prepare-wave prepares only the stories of its own wave, so a returned story does not start again without the User (no to fails_purpose); the implementer of prepare-story must work out from the proposal that a returned entry may not start (raises_cost).
